caption: Leaves of the Witch Hazel Family - 1/3 life size, from Richard E. Weaver, “The Witch Hazel Family (Hamamelidaceae),” Arnoldia 36.3 (1976), pp. 69-109.
alt: Line drawings of fourteen leaves from the witch hazel family, lettered A to N: broad ovals with wavy or toothed edges and strong parallel veins.
bibliography: Weaver, Richard E. "Leaves of the Witch Hazel Family – 1/3 Life Size." "The Witch Hazel Family (Hamamelidaceae)," Arnoldia, vol. 36, no. 3, 1976, pp. 69–109.
